verdict.rationale:
The docs explicitly mention a bulk upload feature for equity promises, letting users process 'multiple promises' at once, which is a genuine bulk operation. However, there is no evidence of broader bulk operations (e.g., batch grants, batch approvals, bulk document generation, or bulk consent workflows) or any AI-native/agentic interface for automating bulk actions—most other workflows described are single-item processes (single grant, single consent, single convertible note).

missing for 10: bulk operations beyond equity-promise upload (e.g., batch grants, batch approvals, batch reporting), any AI-native/agentic bulk automation interface, independent confirmation of bulk feature scope.
